sourceExpressions: The White Blossom emerges victorious in this war, partially because the Blood Curse cure banishes Night Hag influence, which caused mutinies to the White Blossom and partially due to Imperial Lizardfolk intervention, as Karashan joined the Red Blossom despite being under Rayaz administration.As a result of the war, Rayaz gains control over Lake Adgur and the village of Trellisk, Ishyaga conquers Abussa, while Zulbur occupies Rshak and Gasha.
